questions.stem: According to dietitian Carlene Thomas, what is the "best" vegetable to eat?
options: The one that is most popular on social media
The one you actually want to eat
The one with the most vitamin C
questions.evidence: The best vegetables are the ones you actually want to eat.
questions.explanation_ko: 가장 좋은 채소는 실제로 먹고 싶은 채소라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT described as one of the most nutritious cooking methods?
questions.evidence: Boiling vegetables runs the risk of losing water-soluble nutrients including vitamin C, B1 and folate.
questions.explanation_ko: 오래 끓이는 것은 수용성 영양소를 잃을 위험이 있다고 나와 있어 가장 영양가 있는 방법으로 꼽히지 않습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that cooked tomatoes release more lycopene than raw tomatoes?
options: Raw vegetables are always healthier than cooked ones.
For some vegetables, cooking can make certain nutrients more available to the body than eating them raw.
Cooking destroys all nutrients in vegetables.
questions.evidence: cooked tomatoes release more of the antioxidant lycopene than raw tomatoes
questions.explanation_ko: 익힌 토마토가 생 토마토보다 리코펜을 더 많이 방출한다는 내용에서, 조리가 특정 영양소의 체내 이용 가능성을 높일 수 있음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author include Thomas's comment that if vegetables "are going in the trash, they're not in your body"?
options: To emphasize that actually eating vegetables matters more than the cooking method if they go to waste
To argue that all vegetables should be thrown away
To recommend a specific brand of vegetables
questions.evidence: if they’re going in the trash, they’re not in your body
questions.explanation_ko: 이 말은 채소가 버려진다면 조리법이 아무리 좋아도 소용없다는, 실제로 먹는 것이 더 중요하다는 점을 강조하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "leaching" mean in "The nutrients are leaching into the water"?
questions.evidence: leaching into the water, and you’re tossing out the water
questions.explanation_ko: leaching는 영양소가 서서히 물속으로 빠져나간다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 굽는 시간이 더 길어도, 로스팅은 일부 영양소를 유지하면서 천연 당분이 가열되며 풍미를 더한다.
하지만 그것은 생채소와 익힌 채소를 단순 비교하는 것만큼 간단하지는 않다.
팬 볶음이나 소테를 할 때는 채소가 팬에 눌어붙지 않을 만큼 충분한 기름으로 조리하라고 Pankonin은 제안한다.

key_points: A dietitian says the best vegetable is whichever one a person will actually eat, since vegetables that get thrown away provide no nutrition at all.

Cooking methods do affect nutrition, but raw vegetables are not always healthier than cooked ones; cooking can make some nutrients, like lycopene in tomatoes and beta-carotene in carrots, easier for the body to absorb.

Steaming and microwaving are considered among the most nutritious cooking methods because they are quick and require no added fat, while boiling for too long can cause water-soluble nutrients to leach into the cooking water.
A small amount of cooking oil is fine and even helps the body absorb fat-soluble vitamins, and roasting, while requiring more oil and time, adds flavor.
main_idea: Whether cooking helps or hurts a vegetable's nutrition depends on the method used, and experts say the most important thing is choosing vegetables people will actually eat.
restate_sentence: When vegetables are cooked with high heat for a long period of time many nutrients break down.
